skills.name: Tailed Beast Mode
skills.description: After Mecha-Naruto executes <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Naruto - Chakra Bomb</font>, enters <font color="#4dc831">Tailed Beast Mode</font> until the end of the battle, in which he loses all current skills and receives new ones, including <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Kurama - Chakra Bomb</font>, <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Kurama - Energy Recovery</font>, <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Kurama - Tail Sweep</font>, <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Kurama - Claw Strike</font>.

skills.name: Mecha-Kurama - Claw Strike
skills.description: Triggered at the beginning of even-numbered rounds, causes unavoidable damage, <font color="#4dc831">Interruption</font> to the front line of opponent units, causes <font color="#4dc831">Low Float</font> to a random unit hit. All units hit will have their <font color="#4dc831">Mystery Cooldown locked</font> at 1 until the end of the round.

skills.name: Mecha-Kurama - Tail Sweep
skills.description: Triggered at the beginning of odd-numbered rounds, causes damage to the front row of opponent units and causes 25% splash damage to units 1 grid away from all units hit, causes <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> to a random unit hit.

skills.name: Tailed Beast Mode
skills.description: <font color="#4dc831">Additional Skill</font>: Triggered after <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Naruto</font> executes <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Kurama - Energy Recovery</font>, causes damage to up to 12 units in the opponent's field, causes <font color="#4dc831">Repulse</font> to a random unit hit. This skill has additional <font color="#4dc831">Critical Rate</font> increase.

skills.name: Tailed Beast Mode
skills.description: Under <font color="#4dc831">Tailed Beast Mode</font>, Mecha-Naruto is <font color="#4dc831">immune to Debuffs</font> and has <font color="#4dc831">Super Armor</font>. Whenever he executes a <font color="#4dc831">Trigger</font> Skill, increase his <font color="#4dc831">Attack</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Ninjutsu</font> by 20% (stackable).

skills.name: Tailed Beast Mode
skills.description: After executing <font color="#4dc831">Mecha-Kurama - Energy Recovery</font>, additionally executes <font color="#4dc831">Additional Skill: Mecha-Kurama - Tailed Beast Bomb</font>, whenever he's attacked, reduces his Mystery Cooldown by 1 and enters <font color="#4dc831">Explosive Mode</font> until the end of the battle. Under <font color="#4dc831">Explosive Mode</font>, units causing damage to Mecha-Naruto will suffer from a layer of <font color="#4dc831">Inflammation</font>. Whenever units suffering from this Debuff causes Taijutsu damage, that unit will lose 1% max HP. Inflammation can be stacked up to 4 layers.

skills.name: Mecha-Kurama - Energy Recovery
skills.description: Recovers 12% <font color="#4dc831">HP</font> and gains <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 Super Armor</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Advanced Immunity</font> until the end of the round. Additionally in that round, units causing Taijutsu damage to Mecha-Naruto will suffer from <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Ignition</font>.
